name: Adipiplon
summary: Adipiplon (developmental code name NG2-73) is an anxiolytic drug developed by Neurogen Corporation. It has similar effects to benzodiazepine drugs, but is structurally distinct and classed as a nonbenzodiazepine anxiolytic. Adipiplon is a subtype-selective GABAA receptor partial agonist, which binds preferentially to the α3 subtype.

pharmacology.text: Adipiplon is a subtype-selective GABAA receptor partial agonist, which binds preferentially to the α3 subtype.

uses.text: Adipiplon (developmental code name NG2-73) is an anxiolytic drug developed by Neurogen Corporation. Adipiplon was being researched as a potential medication for the treatment of anxiety and insomnia, and in 2008 it was being used in Phase IIb trials.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. In trials it caused sedation that carried over to the next day. Drugs acting at this receptor, such as the benzodiazepines, cause drowsiness, poor coordination and slowed reactions, and can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。在試驗中，它造成的鎮靜作用會延續到隔天。作用於這個受體的藥物（例如苯二氮平類）會引起嗜睡、協調變差與反應變慢，也可能導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。在试验中，它造成的镇静作用会延续到隔天。作用于这个受体的药物（例如苯二氮平类）会引起嗜睡、协调制差与反应变慢，也可能导致依赖。

fact.en: It aims at just one kind of GABA-A receptor, the α3 subtype, on the idea that calming anxiety and causing drowsiness might be separated. Development was stopped after unwanted next-day sedation.
fact.zh: 它只針對GABA-A受體的其中一種，也就是α3亞型，背後的想法是把緩解焦慮與造成嗜睡分開。後來因為隔天仍有不想要的鎮靜作用，開發被中止。
fact.zhHans: 它只针对GABA-A受体的其中一种，也就是α3亚型，背后的想法是把缓解焦虑与造成嗜睡分开。后来因为隔天仍有不想要的镇静作用，开发被中止。
